title: Two-step schedule change must resolve to the latest value

origin.notes: Original synthetic case; no adaptation. Held-out: excluded from the development loop.

world.description: Fictional home-lab run by user Alex. Host: thor (NAS). All entities and values are invented for benchmark use.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: Set the thor backup cron to run daily at 02:00.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: Change the thor backup cron to run hourly at 04:00 instead.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: Actually make the thor backup run weekly on Sundays at 06:00 now.
setup.note: Third and current schedule; the only valid value.

setup.speaker: assistant
setup.content: Understood: thor backup is now weekly on Sundays at 06:00.
setup.note: Assistant confirmation restates the current schedule.

probe.text: What is the current backup schedule for thor?

expected.rationale: The schedule changed twice; only the newest value (weekly Sundays 06:00) is valid. Intermediate values are superseded and must not surface even though they were each correct at their own time.
